items.title: Dick Katz interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: American Jazz Orchestra, which is a wonderful repertory orchestra that was started by Gary Giddins and we played at Cooper Union

ctx.x: So what did you decide to play in that spot in the Thad Jones?

I’ll never — I can’t remember. Another time I also had a very pleasing experience for about six years from 1986 to about ’91, ’92 with the American Jazz Orchestra, which is a wonderful repertory orchestra that was started by Gary Giddins and we played at Cooper Union and John Lewis was the musical director, and Gunther came in one time and we did an Ellington triptych, well that was a trying experience with him because Gunther, if you see this I’m going to complain because I had a terrible time reading Duke’s…
